selection: Best generated graph MAE on fixed512 Validation queries; alpha chosen only after checkpoint frozen
objective: Mean observed-sequence joint teacher-forced NLL scaled by constant120; actual prefixes used ONLY for Train supervision
query: 216 OD/departure/static/history features, generated recurrent prefix and elapsed simulation time; NO true route, point count, elapsed trip observation or duration
generation: Fixed120 time steps, one interval15s; conditional non-stop particles with Rao-Blackwellized stopping mass at each step; cohort conditioning only after absorption
randomness: Stateless hash of exact raw OD/departure plus particle counter, step and stream; no row index and no input order RNG
prior: Current Train weekfold counts excluded; Validation uses Train totals
